title: Malta Year 8 Math Chapter 3 — Angles Practice
question: 12 angle questions, each with a picture: 4 Easy, 4 Medium, 4 Hard.
intro:
**Three levels:**

- Easy: one angle fact
- Medium: isosceles, three angles on a line, parallel lines, outside angle
- Hard: two facts together, or a little algebra

**Answers:** type the number of degrees only.

questions.title: On a line
questions.figure_alt: A straight line with one ray: 64 degrees on the right, x on the left.

questions.title: Around a point
questions.figure_alt: Three rays from one point: 140 degrees, 95 degrees and x.

questions.title: In a triangle
questions.figure_alt: A triangle with base angles 72 and 41 degrees and x at the top.

questions.title: Two lines cross
questions.figure_alt: Two crossing lines: 58 degrees and x next to it.

questions.title: Isosceles
questions.figure_alt: An isosceles triangle with equal sides marked; one base angle is 52 degrees and the top angle is x.

questions.title: Three on a line
questions.figure_alt: A straight line with two rays: a right angle, 35 degrees, and x between them.

questions.title: Parallel lines
questions.figure_alt: Two parallel lines and a slanted line: 124 degrees at the top crossing, x at the bottom crossing.

questions.title: Outside the triangle
questions.figure_alt: A triangle with inside angles 38 and 67 degrees; the base is extended and the outside angle is y.

questions.title: With algebra
questions.figure_alt: A straight line with one ray: 40 degrees on the right and 2x on the left.

questions.title: Isosceles and outside
questions.figure_alt: An isosceles triangle with equal sides marked; the base is extended on the right with an outside angle of 110 degrees; the top angle is x.

questions.title: Around a point with algebra
questions.figure_alt: Three rays from one point: angles x, 2x and 150 degrees.

questions.title: Parallel lines with algebra
questions.figure_alt: Two parallel lines and a slanted line: on the left side between the lines, x at the top and 2x at the bottom.

takeaway:
- Straight line: \(180^\circ\). Around a point: \(360^\circ\). Triangle: \(180^\circ\).
- Opposite angles, F angles and Z angles are equal. C angles add up to \(180^\circ\).
